Congratulations to our newly-crowned Miss Grand Philippines 2025, Emma Mary Tiglao from Pampanga! 👑 @tiglaoEMMA 

A proud Kapampangan, Emma is a seasoned model, TV host, and beauty queen whose elegance and eloquence have long captivated audiences. Beyond the stage, she is an advocate for culture and empowerment, using her voice to inspire and uplift others. 

Now, she begins her Grand journey as she represents the Philippines at the upcoming Miss Grand International 2025 in Bangkok, Thailand this October 18, 2025. Let’s rally behind Emma as she carries the Filipino spirit to the global stage! 🇵🇭

#WALANGPASOK | Base sa anunsyo ng Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG), suspendido ang pasok sa lahat ng antas ng paaralan at tanggapan ng gobyerno sa buong Metro Manila bukas, Agosto 26, 2025 (Martes), dahil sa inaasahang sama ng panahon.

Patuloy namang kikilos at maghahatid ng serbisyong medikal, law enforcement, traffic management, disaster at emergency response at iba pang essential services ang mga ahensiya ng QC Government.

Ipinauubaya rin sa pamunuan ng mga pribadong kumpanya at opisina ang desisyon kung sususpendihin ang kanilang mga operasyon.

Mag-ingat po tayong lahat, QCitizens!

#StaySafeQC
